reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — nothing actionable is being raised against the counterparty.

The cited provisions are license-scope limits (Field of Use confined to the Licensed Technology, no Derivative Works of the Licensed Technology, no sublicensing/distribution of the licensed programs), not covenants restricting the businesses Customer may operate or the products it may buy or build; the rule's concern (restrictive covenants on our business) is not triggered, and the fallback's mechanics (named competing product, 12-month cap, internal-development carve-out) are conceptually inapplicable to a grant-scope limitation.

The rationale correctly declines to double-count the change-of-control/competitive-acquirer consent standard (p0134) and the Article XXII right of first refusal, which belong to the assignment/change-of-control rule, and correctly treats the three-year employee non-solicit as a personnel covenant outside this rule.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction binding Customer remains, corroborating the compliant classification.
